description: This file defines the CanvasController class, which manages a WebView for rendering and capturing snapshots of a canvas in an Android application. It includes functions for navigation, debugging, state management, and snapshot generation in different formats.

classes.name: CanvasController
classes.description: A controller class for managing a WebView-based canvas, including navigation, debugging, state management, and snapshot functionalities.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Associates a WebView with the controller and initializes it by loading the scaffold.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the WebView from the controller.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Sets the URL to navigate the WebView to.

methods.name: currentUrl
methods.description: Returns the current URL loaded in the WebView.

methods.name: isDefaultCanvas
methods.description: Checks if the current URL is the default scaffold, indicating no custom canvas loaded.

methods.name: setDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug status display.

methods.name: setDebugStatus
methods.description: Sets the debug status title and subtitle.

methods.name: onPageFinished
methods.description: Applies debug status and home canvas state after page load completes.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Updates the JSON state representing the home canvas.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code in the WebView and returns the result.

methods.name: snapshotPngBase64
methods.description: Captures a PNG snapshot of the WebView content and encodes it in Base64.

methods.name: snapshotBase64
methods.description: Captures a snapshot in specified format and quality, optionally scaled, and encodes it in Base64.
